---
name: Feature request
about: Propose a new operational signal, view, or workflow
title: "[feature] "
labels: enhancement
---

## Operational problem

What problem in real engineering workflows does this solve? Avoid
proposals that require fabricating or synthesizing data — every
GitSense signal must trace back to real GitHub repository activity.

## Proposed behavior

Describe the desired user-facing behavior in plain language.

## Signal source

Which existing service / engine would produce the signal? If a new
one is required, sketch it briefly:

- analytics_service?
- insight_engine?
- health_service?
- heatmap_service?
- new module?

## Out of scope

What this proposal explicitly does NOT include (helps reviewers
understand the boundary).

## Alternatives considered

Anything you considered and rejected, and why.
